german.name: German Language
german.about: German is the most spoken native language in Europe and the key to unlocking educational and professional opportunities in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Our CEFR-aligned programme takes you from absolute beginner to B2 — the level required for Ausbildung, university admission, and most professional roles in Germany.
german.whyLearn: Germany is actively recruiting skilled workers from Africa. With B1 or B2 German, you can access tuition-free university education, Ausbildung apprenticeships with a stipend, and nursing or hospitality roles across the DACH region.
outcomes: Communicate confidently in everyday and professional German contexts
Read and write German at CEFR B1/B2 standard
Understand German culture, workplace etiquette, and social norms
Pass Goethe-Institut or TELC B1/B2 examinations
Prepare job applications, CVs, and interviews in German

levels.label: Beginner
levels.desc: Introductory vocabulary, greetings, numbers, and basic sentence structures.

levels.label: Elementary
levels.desc: Everyday conversations, travel German, and simple writing tasks.

levels.label: Intermediate
levels.desc: Workplace German, extended conversations, and reading comprehension.

levels.label: Upper-Intermediate
levels.desc: Fluent interaction, complex texts, and professional writing — Ausbildung ready.

english.name: English Language
english.about: English is the global language of business, science, and international communication. Our course is designed for learners who need English for professional advancement, academic study, or international travel.
english.whyLearn: English proficiency opens doors to global universities, multinational companies, and digital economy roles. It is the primary language of the internet, international tourism, and hospitality management.
outcomes: Communicate effectively in professional and academic environments
Write clear business emails, reports, and presentations
Understand spoken English at natural speed in varied accents
Prepare for IELTS, TOEFL, or Cambridge examinations

levels.label: Beginner
levels.desc: Foundational vocabulary, simple sentences, and basic listening skills.

levels.label: Elementary
levels.desc: Everyday communication, travel English, and basic reading.

levels.label: Intermediate
levels.desc: Workplace English, emails, and independent conversation.

levels.label: Upper-Inter.
levels.desc: Professional fluency, complex reading, and formal writing.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.desc: Near-native fluency, academic writing, and exam preparation.

french.name: French Language
french.about: French is spoken by over 300 million people across 5 continents and is an official language of the United Nations and the African Union.
french.whyLearn: French opens opportunities in diplomacy, NGOs, tourism, and Francophone Africa.
outcomes: Hold everyday and professional conversations in French
Read and write French at B1/B2 CEFR level
Navigate Francophone African business and cultural contexts
Prepare for DELF or DALF examinations

levels.label: Beginner
levels.desc: Basic greetings, numbers, and survival French.

levels.label: Elementary
levels.desc: Travel French, simple conversations, and everyday tasks.

levels.label: Intermediate
levels.desc: Professional and social French, extended reading and writing.

levels.label: Upper-Inter.
levels.desc: Fluent communication and preparation for DELF B2.

spanish.name: Spanish Language
spanish.about: Spanish is the second most spoken native language in the world and highly valuable in tourism, international trade, and Latin American markets.
spanish.whyLearn: Spanish opens access to the Latin American market and tourism opportunities worldwide.
outcomes: Conduct basic to intermediate conversations in Spanish
Read Spanish media and professional texts
Write emails and professional documents in Spanish
Prepare for DELE examinations

levels.label: Intermediate
levels.desc: Professional Spanish and DELE B1 preparation.

mandarin.name: Mandarin Chinese
mandarin.about: Mandarin Chinese is the most spoken language globally and essential for trade and diplomacy.
mandarin.whyLearn: China is one of Africa’s largest trading partners, creating strong demand for Mandarin speakers.
outcomes: Read and write Chinese characters
Hold basic to intermediate Mandarin conversations
Understand Chinese business culture
Prepare for HSK examinations

arabic.name: Arabic Language
arabic.about: Arabic is spoken by over 400 million people and is essential in diplomacy, religion, and Gulf economies.
arabic.whyLearn: Arabic opens opportunities in diplomacy, Islamic finance, and Gulf-state employment.
outcomes: Read and write Arabic script
Communicate in Arabic professionally
Understand Arabic cultural contexts

kiswahili.name: Kiswahili
kiswahili.about: Kiswahili is the most widely spoken African language and a major language across East Africa.
kiswahili.whyLearn: Kiswahili is essential for East African business, government, and diplomacy.
outcomes: Communicate confidently in Kiswahili
Read and write standard Kiswahili
Engage in East African professional settings

japanese.name: Japanese Language
japanese.about: Japanese is the language of one of the world’s most technologically advanced economies.
japanese.whyLearn: Japanese language skills support migration and work opportunities in Japan.
outcomes: Read Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji
Communicate in workplace Japanese
Prepare for JLPT certification
